title: Why Hyderabad Polls Have Become Significant For Narendra Modi, Amit Shah, Owaisi And KCR | CRUX
description: BJP has been pulling out all stops to make a mark in Hyderabad municipal elections scheduled for December 1. The saffron part is on an offensive against the ruling KCR and Asaduddin Owaisi's AIMIM who hold control of GHMC. The comments from BJP leaders who are campaigning in the city have veered from comparing Owaisi to Jinnah and the latest "surgical strike in old Hyderabad". The remarks have nevertheless evoked sharp response from Owaisi and TRS working president KT Rama Rao who don't want to cede any space to the saffron party in the upcoming civic polls. #GHMCelections2020 #AsaduddinOwaisi #TejasviSurya #GHMCElections

asr.full_text: A little faith and we'll destroy it. A little faith and we'll throw it away. Let's bring the world together, KCR as its leader. OIC becomes strong in Bihar. If you vote for OIC here, OIC becomes strong in a Muslim locality in Karnataka. If you support OIC here, OIC will become strong in Uttar Pradesh. And what does OIC mean? Who is OIC? OIC is Muhammad Ali Jinnah's new avatar. We must defeat him. Today, a BJP leader said that if we win Hyderabad's election, we will do surgical strike in old city Patapattam. We will do surgical strike in old city Patapattam and remove Pakistanis and Rohingyas from there. I am telling BJP people that that who will you do the surgical strike on? They are people of India. I want to say one thing today. The people of Sindh are trying to separate us. Today some people don't want to see Hyderabad as peaceful and free. They want to separate and build the world in their own eyes. They want to make a political decision about religion. KCR is the leader who believes in one thing. Let's take the whole world with us. KCR is the leader. you

The "surgical strike" statement is attributed to a BJP leader, while the video records political responses, indicating reporting or discussion rather than a solicitation for money, credentials, or participation in a deceptive scheme. The request to follow the CRUX account is ordinary audience engagement and is not connected to payment, investment, data submission, or a promised benefit.
